skills.name: Subtract numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer/whole number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole
skills.definition: Regroup or borrow 1 from the whole number part to resolve a negative fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to its lowest terms.
